name: Bead Pattern Generator Color Palettes
description: Simple color palette data for a responsive PWA bead-pattern generator.
notes: HEX/RGB values are digital screen references and may differ from physical beads.
Use the selected palette for image-to-bead color matching; do not treat HEX as a physical color measurement.
Quick Start is a generic beginner palette, not a manufacturer color card.

palettes.name: Quick Start
palettes.description: Beginner-friendly 5mm palette. The app may use this as the default recommendation.

palettes.name: Artkal S
palettes.description: Artkal S main colors plus SE extension colors.
